metadataReview.note: Reviewed missing start date at month precision: the French defence historical service catalogs a contemporary view of the town and citadel of Ghent under siege in March 1678. The BnF title dates the king’s personal conduct of the siege to 4 March, which is not treated as the opening day because investment preceded his arrival. Only March 1678 is entered. Existing year-only end and sourced siege-town coordinates remain at their original precision; no exact opening or surrender day is inferred.
